levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد

notes: The report's own chain: three co-transmitter levels converge with «جَمِيعاً» (rule 3), one route.
The oath «لَسَمِعْتُ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ مِنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ» is a remark by a different transmitter (Abd al-Hamid) for the same saying: a variant group, never a route (rule 4).
The Imam named only in the words after the chain («سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ يَقُولُ») is imam_in_text, the last link; «عليه السلام» is left out.
«عَنْ أَبِيهِ» after the Hasan ibn Abi Hamza is a relation.
